cards.front: Which four editions exist in Windows 10?
cards.back: Home, Pro, Pro for Workstations, Enterprise.

cards.front: Which three editions exist in Windows 11?
cards.back: Home, Pro, Enterprise.

cards.front: Does Windows 10/11 Home support joining an Active Directory domain?
cards.back: No. Domain join requires Pro, Pro for Workstations, or Enterprise.

cards.front: Does Windows Home support BitLocker?
cards.back: No. BitLocker requires Pro or higher. Windows 11 Home has 'Device Encryption' which is similar but consumer-grade.

cards.front: Where is the BitLocker recovery key stored in Windows 11 Home (Device Encryption) vs an enterprise BitLocker deployment?
cards.back: Home / Device Encryption: in the user's Microsoft account. Enterprise BitLocker: in Active Directory.

cards.front: Can Windows Home act as a Remote Desktop server (host)?
cards.back: No. Home can only be a client. RDP server requires Pro or higher.

cards.front: What does gpedit.msc do, and which editions include it?
cards.back: Opens the Local Group Policy Editor. Available in Pro and higher; NOT in Home.

cards.front: Maximum RAM in 64-bit Windows 10/11 Pro?
cards.back: 2 TB.

cards.front: Maximum RAM in 64-bit Windows 11 Enterprise?
cards.back: 6 TB.

cards.front: Maximum RAM in Windows 10/11 Home (64-bit)?
Is there a 32-bit version of Windows 11?
cards.back: No. Windows 11 requires a 64-bit CPU.

cards.front: What does the 'N' in a Windows N edition mean?
cards.back: No bundled media player or multimedia utilities. Sold in Europe for regulatory compliance.

cards.front: How do you add media playback features back to a Windows N edition?
cards.back: Install the Media Feature Pack via Settings > Apps > Optional Features.

cards.front: Which Windows edition supports ReFS on the desktop?
cards.back: Windows 11 Enterprise (and Windows 10 Pro for Workstations). The same file system used in Windows Server.

cards.front: What's the difference between a Windows domain and a Windows workgroup?
cards.back: Domain: central management via Active Directory, used at work. Workgroup: each device managed independently, typical for home networks.

cards.front: Which Windows 11 edition adds MDM and MAM management?
cards.back: Windows 11 Enterprise.

cards.front: Which Windows 11 edition includes Hyper-V virtualization?
cards.back: Windows 11 Pro (and Enterprise).

cards.front: What is AppLocker and which edition includes it?
cards.back: Allow / block list for applications. Available in Windows 10 Enterprise.

cards.front: What is BranchCache?
cards.back: Caches data at a remote site so it doesn't have to be re-fetched over the WAN. Included in Windows 10 Enterprise.

cards.front: When did Microsoft announce Windows 10 Home and Pro would reach end of support?
cards.back: October 14, 2025.

cards.front: Difference between an in-place upgrade and a clean install for Windows?
cards.back: In-place: keeps applications, user data, settings. Run from inside the current OS. Clean install: wipes everything and reinstalls from boot media.

cards.front: What AI assistant did Microsoft build into Windows 11?
cards.back: Windows Copilot.
